evidenceBoundaries: Candidate-only localhost CI run; the public HTTPS workflow step was skipped. No public run result is claimed.
All copied JSON and PNG files retain original bytes. The compact audit, this manifest and README are derived descriptions.
The ZIP is a lossless subset containing all 26 immediate JSON files except report.json; it is not the original 181040692-byte official artifact ZIP.
Six standalone reading JSON files also appear in the immediate JSON ZIP intentionally for convenient review.
Post pointer facts are captured native trusted events in simulated touch Chromium. This is not a physical-phone test.
Ending scroll evidence consists of CDP send acknowledgements and actual DOM measurements. It is not a separate native pointer event trace.
Native capture/microtask dialog snapshots do not replace the independent UI assertion realOutroOpened after fresh result-button activation.
The main post route settles once; the three extended routes are legitimate completed replays and add three chapter runs.
